name: FUN_ALLOC_PROCESSES
description: This table contains the properties of an allocation process, including the name, description, status, and effective dates.

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of allocation process.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies the status of the allocation process. Possible values are DRAFT and FINAL.

columns.name: VALIDATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Validation status of allocation processes. Possible values are V for validated, N for not yet validated, and E for validated with errors.

columns.name: VALIDATION_ERRORS
columns.description: Validation error details of allocation processes.

columns.name: LAST_VALIDATION_DATE
columns.description: Last validation date of allocation process.

columns.name: LAST_VALIDATION_SUCCESS_DATE
columns.description: Last validation date when validation was successful for allocation process.

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
